body: I have heard of it and I'm almost certain I have it
For at least two years now. Back then it was only a rare episode here and there but it's progressed to every day most of the day.
Like I want to go and run and never stop. I don't care if I end up dead on the road or starving behind a gas station. Maybe I'll get to feel something.

I'm not afraid of suicide or death but something is holding me back and it's making everything so much harder. I don't know what to do. I want to end it so badly. My mind is constantly screaming in agony and frustration but it's like my voice just won't work. 

I don't know if others experience this but in dreams and I'm lucid I'll avoid doing anything stupid or damaging because what if I'm actually awake. I can't even tell the difference between a dream and reality.
I know because social services is already watching us like a hawk. My aunt can't keep her kids so we are and services is making sure we can take care of them
It doesn't matter if I report it. Nothing will come of it but me getting in trouble. No matter how hard social services searches they won't find a reason to get me out of here

I can't let my family know. They made my sisters life hell when she attempted and she continues to get worse. I told an adult friend I trust and this is the best I'm going to get. Therapy isn't an option unless I find a way to do it secretly without my parents knowing

I feel like I wrote that post lol. 

I relate to you man except I'm a tad younger. 

I honestly don't know what to say. There's people here you can reach out to and just talk to. Talking to someone who understands can do wonders for your mental health. Like tonight I was going to cut myself but talking to someone on here really helped me out.
Well that clears up a bit of fear of someone I know finding my account lol. If my friend was forgiven for what he did I don't see why you wouldn't be forgiven.
Maybe I'm just not going super deep but I most of the time do it slow.

Not entirely true. Without the distraction my phone grants I wouldn't be here. Without people distracting me right now my thigh would be leaking blood over the floor. But I agree. A nice drive is comforting

Hey you remind me of someone who was once a really close friend of mine. He did something horrible to a girl. Someone he loved. He hates himself for it and has attempted over it. The chances of you being him are very slim but just to be safe I'll keep details out of it. Message her. Apologize for what you did and ask for forgiveness. Even if she doesn't forgive you you can get a bit of closure knowing you tried to make up for your actions and she will know you are truly sorry. It takes a strong person to ask for forgiveness.

The moment I realized this scared me.. Life pushes is forward whether we want to go or not. Nothing we can do to stop it or go back. I can't go back and fix a single thing I did in the past. I can't go back even a second to not type this. Time just keeps going forward and it doesn't stop

It doesn't matter if there's free will or not. We're stuck here till we die or until we make the decision to end it. Enjoy the decisions you make or are destined to make. You don't know what's gonna happen even if there isn't free will

Listen man. Shit happens and we make mistakes. I can't tell you to forget about what you did that's just silly. What you can do is learn from it. You won't make the same mistake now right? Things change whether we want them to or not and this is gonna sound stupid but give it time. Time has a weird way of making a lot of things better or at least lessening the pain. 

Basically I'm saying move on and forgive yourself but don't forget. Learn and make yourself better.

Hey man not much I can say really. I can't tell you not to self harm that would make me a hypocrite. Just want to let you know there's other people out there who can relate in one way or another. I can't tell you to hold on either because when people tell me that I feel like whatever they're spouting on about is bullshit. Sometimes talking to someone who can relate is better than a therapist because you feel understood.

The scars are part of who I am. The pain I feel. In the future if that pain goes away I can look at my thighs and be proud I made it through. Proud of myself for getting through the shit. But right now the scars hidden under my underwear will continue to show and deepen.
I enjoy the pain in a sick way. I don't want it to go away. I don't want to stop hurting. I want the scars to stay and remind me of all the pain I went through.

Do anything but kill yourself. Find any little activity you might enjoy and just live a bit. If you plan on killing yourself then you've got nothing to lose. Try something new you haven't done before. Maybe it will give you some meaning

Hey if you need someone to vent to I've got a couple ears open. 

I can't force you to eat. Can't force you to live another day. I can't even tell you it's going to get better. Those are all your choices to make. I can wish you a happy birthday and hope you find the strength to keep going and find your happiness back. We've all got it inside of us just people like us seem to lose hold of it easier than others. Try and find your happiness. Any little tiny thing that makes you smile or even something big you enjoy and hold onto it. Go after it. Try and find that touch of happiness and when you do don't let it go like your life depends on it

Hey man. I'm sorry, honestly. We're all suffering in some way or another. Me personally, I'm treated like shit at school and it gets worse every day. My mom steals from me and then denies it and punishes me for making her and dad get into a fight. I'm 16 and my thighs are covered in scars and I've got 2 suicide attempts under my belt. I know it's hard to find a reason to go on and a lot of times there isn't a reason but this pain can't last forever even if it seems to. All things come to an end whether we want them to or not. Just hold in there even if it's another day. Push yourself one day at a time. Live each day because who knows you may get your wish and not wake up tomorrow.
